text:
marie: Quick postmortem follow-up: we need owners for remediations and a trimmed runbook for oncall. Targets: owners assigned today, runbook PR by Fri.
tony: I'll take cache warmup and add a prime script + staging test plan. ETA Thu.
sylvia: I'll update the escalation matrix and short triage steps (kubectl, grafana checks).
runbook-bot: Reminder: add subtasks to INF-4001 (pm follow-ups).
tony: prime script example:
python tools/prime_cache.py --prefixes s3://telemetry/top-prefixes.txt --concurrency 3
marie: Triage checklist (to pin): 1) confirm alarm in grafana; 2) check cache hit rate; 3) run prime or scale cache; 4) consider model fallback. Keep it to 4 steps.
sylvia: Escalation thresholds proposal: page infra if error_rate > 3% for 5m OR p99 > 1.5s for 10m. Otherwise notify oncall and create incident.
tony: I'll add a small canary plan for the cache change (staging replay + 5% traffic canary).
marie: I'll create subtasks and set weekly check-ins until closed. Please add PR links when ready.
runbook-bot: Tasks created: INF-4002 (cache warmup) -> tony, INF-4003 (escalation) -> sylvia. Deadlines set.
sylvia: I'll post the updated runbook card in #oncall when PR is up.
marie: thanks everyone — we'll review on Friday sync. :thumbsup:
